command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

VV=$(vep 2>&1 | awk '/ensembl  *:/{print $3; exit}')

echo "== a THIRD annotator on the same reference, GFF and VCF =="
# VEP --gff wants the GFF sorted by position, bgzipped and tabix-indexed. The Ensembl-style
# ID=gene:/ID=transcript: prefixes it needs are the same ones bcftools csq needs.
sort -k1,1 -k4,4n genes.gff | bgzip -c > genes.sorted.gff.gz
tabix -p gff genes.sorted.gff.gz
vep -i variants.vcf --gff genes.sorted.gff.gz --fasta chrA.fa --vcf \
    -o vep.vcf --no_stats --force_overwrite --species custom > vep.log 2>&1 || { tail -20 vep.log; exit 1; }
grep -v '^##' vep.vcf | cut -f3,8

NV=$(awk '!/^#/{n++} END{print n+0}' vep.vcf)
NCSQ=$(awk '!/^#/ && $8 ~ /CSQ=/{n++} END{print n+0}' vep.vcf)
test "$NV"   = "5" || { echo "expected 5 records, got $NV"; exit 1; }
test "$NCSQ" = "5" || { echo "only $NCSQ of 5 records carry a CSQ -- VEP did not read the GFF"; exit 1; }

echo "== normalise VEP into the same five columns as the other two =="
cat > norm-vep.awk <<'AWKEOF'
BEGIN{FS="\t"; OFS="\t"}
!/^#/{
  c=""; n=split($8,parts,";")
  for(i=1;i<=n;i++) if (parts[i] ~ /^CSQ=/) c=substr(parts[i],5)
  split(c,f,"|")
  csq=f[2]; sub(/&.*/,"",csq); sub(/_variant$/,"",csq)
  pp=f[15]; aa=f[16]; pos="."; r="."; a="."
  # VEP writes X for a frameshifted residue -- "unknown", not an amino acid, so nothing to compare
  if (aa ~ /^[A-Z]\/[A-Z*]$/ && aa !~ /\/X$/ && pp ~ /^[0-9]+$/) { split(aa,s,"/"); r=s[1]; a=s[2]; pos=pp }
  else if (aa ~ /^[A-Z*]$/ && pp ~ /^[0-9]+$/)                   { r=aa; a=aa; pos=pp }
  print $3, csq, pos, r, a
}
AWKEOF
awk -f norm-vep.awk vep.vcf | sort > vep.norm
cat vep.norm

echo "== VEP vs the planted truth, and vs both other annotators =="
sort -o truth.tsv truth.tsv; sort -o snpeff.norm snpeff.norm; sort -o bcsq.norm bcsq.norm
VT=no; VS=no; VB=no
diff -q truth.tsv   vep.norm >/dev/null && VT=yes || diff truth.tsv   vep.norm || true
diff -q snpeff.norm vep.norm >/dev/null && VS=yes || diff snpeff.norm vep.norm || true
diff -q bcsq.norm   vep.norm >/dev/null && VB=yes || diff bcsq.norm   vep.norm || true
test "$VT" = yes && test "$VS" = yes && test "$VB" = yes

echo "== the frameshift codon: which tool is the outlier =="
SNPFS=$(awk -F'\t' '$3=="v4_fs"{split($8,p,"ANN="); split(p[2],g,"|"); h=g[11]; gsub(/[^0-9]/,"",h); print h; exit}' ann.vcf)
BCFFS=$(awk -F'\t' '$3=="v4_fs"{split($8,p,"BCSQ="); split(p[2],g,"|"); h=g[6]; sub(/[^0-9].*/,"",h); print h; exit}' csq.vcf)
VEPFS=$(awk -F'\t' '$3=="v4_fs"{split($8,p,"CSQ="); split(p[2],g,"|"); print g[15]; exit}' vep.vcf)
printf 'snpEff %s   VEP %s   bcftools %s\n' "$SNPFS" "$VEPFS" "$BCFFS"
test "$VEPFS" = "$SNPFS" || { echo "VEP and snpEff no longer agree on the frameshift codon"; exit 1; }
test "$BCFFS" != "$VEPFS" || { echo "NOTE: bcftools now agrees too -- conventions converged"; exit 1; }

echo "== the three raw spellings, side by side (observation) =="
{
printf 'variant\tsnpEff\tbcftools csq\tVEP\n'
for v in v1_syn v2_mis v3_non v4_fs v5_spl; do
  S=$(awk -F'\t' -v v="$v" '$3==v{split($8,p,"ANN="); split(p[2],g,"|"); printf "%s / %s", g[2], (g[11]==""?"-":g[11])}' ann.vcf)
  B=$(awk -F'\t' -v v="$v" '$3==v{split($8,p,"BCSQ="); split(p[2],g,"|"); printf "%s / %s", g[1], (g[6]==""?"-":g[6])}' csq.vcf)
  P=$(awk -F'\t' -v v="$v" '$3==v{split($8,p,"CSQ="); split(p[2],g,"|"); printf "%s / %s", g[2], (g[16]==""?"-":g[15]":"g[16])}' vep.vcf)
  printf '%s\t%s\t%s\t%s\n' "$v" "$S" "$B" "$P"
done
} | tee conventions3.txt

{
printf 'Variant annotation -- THREE annotators on one reference, one GFF, one VCF\n'
printf 'vep_version\t%s\n' "$VV"
printf 'records_with_csq\t%s of 5   (assert 5 -- a GFF VEP cannot read yields records with no CSQ)\n' "$NCSQ"
printf 'vep_exact\t%s   (assert yes -- EXACT vs planted consequences)\n' "$VT"
printf 'vep_vs_snpeff\t%s   (assert yes)\n' "$VS"
printf 'vep_vs_bcftools\t%s   (assert yes)\n' "$VB"
printf 'three_way_agreement\tyes   (assert yes -- all three, after normalising three different notations)\n'
printf 'frameshift_codon\tsnpEff %s / VEP %s / bcftools %s   (assert VEP == snpEff, bcftools differs)\n' "$SNPFS" "$VEPFS" "$BCFFS"
printf 'note\tthe earlier two-tool page could only say the frameshift positions were irreconcilable.\n'
printf 'note\tA third annotator settles WHICH is unusual: snpEff and VEP both name the first\n'
printf 'note\taffected codon (34); bcftools starts at the last intact one (33) and spells out the\n'
printf 'note\tretranslated tail. Majority is not correctness, but it tells you which convention to\n'
printf 'note\texpect and which to special-case.\n'
printf 'note\tVEP writes X for a frameshifted residue -- unknown, not an amino acid -- so it is\n'
printf 'note\texcluded from the comparison rather than matched against a letter.\n'
} | tee smoke-check-vep.txt
echo "SMOKE CHECK PASSED"
